Veterans Benefits: California partially excludes qualifying military retirement and Survivor Benefit Plan income—up to $20,000 for tax years 2025-2029, subject to federal AGI limits. Veterans rated 100% disabled for a service-connected disability or compensated at the 100% rate due to individual unemployability may qualify for an assessed-value property-tax exemption. Additional programs include dependent college fee waivers, disabled-veteran vehicle fee exemptions, and CalVet home loans.
Description: Goleta is a coastal Santa Barbara County city with exceptionally expensive housing and a mild, marine-influenced Mediterranean climate. It hosts a specialized aerospace and defense-electronics cluster anchored by an RTX (Raytheon) electronic-warfare engineering and manufacturing facility, reinforced by nearby UC Santa Barbara. Violent crime runs well below the national average.
